name: sim_assoc_bundle_torch_foundation
description: Torch-native Associated Bundle foundation: principal U(1) bundles, transition functions g(θ)=e^{iθ}, holonomy products, winding numbers, cocycle conditions, Chern classes — all torch float64 with autograd. numpy→torch migration proof-of-concept.

pytorch.reason: Transition functions g(θ)=e^{iθ} as cos/sin pairs, holonomy products, winding number tracking — all torch float64 with autograd

z3.reason: UNSAT: holonomy = 1 ∧ holonomy = -1 impossible (single-valued holonomy constraint)

cvc5.reason: z3 constraint solving sufficient for holonomy uniqueness UNSAT

sympy.reason: Symbolic winding number and holonomy formula exp(2πi * w)

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed for U(1) bundle transitions

geomstats.reason: Riemannian geometry backend not needed for bundle migration

e3nn.reason: Equivariant neural networks not required for bundle foundation

rustworkx.reason: Graph algorithms not applicable to transition functions

xgi.reason: Hypergraph structure not needed for principal bundles

toponetx.reason: Topological complexes not required for associated bundle

gudhi.reason: Persistent homology not needed for bundle foundation

P2_mobius_bundle_holonomy.description: Half-winding bundle (w=0.5) has holonomy hol = -1 (orientation reversal)

P4_holonomy_loop_integration.description: Holonomy around full loop S¹ equals exp(2πi*w)

P5_bundle_triviality_from_holonomy.description: Bundle triviality is determined by holonomy = 1

P6_cocycle_condition.description: Cocycle condition g₀₁ * g₁₂ = g₀₂ holds for transition functions

P7_sympy_chern_class.description: sympy: c₁(E) = winding number for line bundle

P8_section_over_bundle.description: A section over the bundle is well-defined and nonzero

B2_transition_unitary.description: Transition function g(θ) has unit norm for all θ

B3_winding_continuity.description: Holonomy varies continuously with winding number

migration_notes: This sim establishes the torch-native pattern for Associated Bundle family migration. Next: port associated bundle lego sims to use these primitives.
